scope: Implement the live server-backed practice lifecycle from Calling selection through result and retry
Add authoritative practice-only pause and resume with monotonic challenge lifecycle revisions
Connect the WP-010 combat scene to strict session, challenge, command, snapshot, result, and reconnect protocol state
Add focused lifecycle, protocol, deterministic match, and live phone-browser verification
non_goals: Wallet or Nimiq Pay identity integration, rewarded challenges, claims, or real funds
Offline or local product play, PvP, matchmaking, leaderboards, or sharing
Durable match recovery across server process restarts or horizontal scaling
Production artwork, audio, or new third-party runtime dependencies
The expanded WP-014 412x915, visual-regression, degraded-network, and performance gates
skipped_checks: Physical Android and iOS testing: no release-testing environment was provided.
Nimiq Pay WebView and wallet-provider testing: deferred to WP-012 and the external release environment.
The 412x915 project, visual-regression baselines, degraded-network matrix, and performance budgets: owned by WP-014.
Production artwork and audio: owned by WP-015; WP-011 retains code-drawn placeholders.
residual_risks: Practice authority remains in one Render process; a restart or session expiry ends the current match and the client offers a fresh Clash rather than durable recovery.
Horizontal multi-instance scaling still requires sticky routing or a shared durable session and simulation store.
The browser bearer token remains in sessionStorage and therefore depends on later CSP and XSS hardening.
The client bundle is approximately 1.391 MB minified and 384.5 kB gzip and retains the chunk-size warning.
Safe-area and touch behavior pass emulated Chromium/WebKit phone projects but still require physical device and Nimiq Pay WebView validation.
